title: BetterWorld
description: BetterWorld is a feature-rich Minecraft modpack that enhances quality of life, overhauls The End, and adds new structures for a more immersive adventure.
body:
**_BetterWorld_** _transforms Minecraft with new structures, an overhauled End, and a variety of mods that enhance exploration, building, and survival. Blending adventure with quality-of-life improvements, it offers a fresh yet balanced experience for every player._                     **_WARNING: ONE OF THE MODPACKS IS NOT MADE/PURCHASED BY ME SO YOU CAN DOWNLOAD IT FROM_**
